project_scope: Scoped Material Finish Update for Expo React Native (Mirrors Wheel & FREQUENCY LAB)

material_finish_blueprint.concept: Logo-Matching Metallic Mirror Chrome Finish with Infrared Dynamic Edge Reflection

layer_1_base_bevel.description: Outer metallic dark border providing specular contrast

layer_2_inner_specular_core.description: Bright white high-glint hairline stroke directly inside the outer bevel

layer_3_infrared_glow_bleed.description: Subtle infrared reflection bleeding through the chrome surface

mirrors_wheel_specifics.ring_finishes: Apply multi-stop mirror chrome LinearGradient to outer and inner segment borders, concentric bounding rings, and center 'MIRRORS 96' medal disc.
mirrors_wheel_specifics.active_state_preservation: Keep 432Hz chakra spectrum hues (bright & dim) for selected/primary harmonic keys, wrapping segment boundaries with high-gloss mirror strokes rather than replacing functional color feedback.
mirrors_wheel_specifics.butterfly_view_preservation: Attractor curves & infinity loops rendered with metallic silver & infrared dual-stroke lines with varying opacity.

frequency_lab_specifics.geometry_finishes: Sacred geometry vector connections (Tree of Life, Merkaba, Metatron, VE64, Sri Yantra, Torus, Phi Spiral, Icosahedron) enhanced with metallic chrome stroke gradients and specular node bevel rings.
frequency_lab_specifics.telemetry_and_controls: HUD frames, corner brackets, and Solfeggio chip borders upgraded with mirror bevel stroke borders, ensuring taps and gesture callbacks stay 100% vector-interactive without blocking overlays.

visual_enhancers.mirror_gloss_effect: Multi-stop linear gradient stroke with specular white highlights
visual_enhancers.matrix_rain_overlay: Vector matrix ASCII characters in low-opacity emerald/cyan
visual_enhancers.hud_corner_brackets: 2.5px infrared brutalist accent brackets with specular chrome caps
visual_enhancers.no_transparent_overlays_rule: Containers or overlays over interactive graphics must use semi-solid opaque background (#000000ee or #0a0505) with 1px border stroke, avoiding raw non-blurred transparency.

motion.pulse_cycle: 4000ms sine wave easing for ambient glows
motion.rotation_cycle: 60000ms continuous linear rotation for wheel elements
motion.active_key_transition: Immediate state response on tap with scale grow on SVG node circles

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based test identifiers (e.g. data-testid="mirrors-wheel-spin-button", data-testid="frequency-node-kether", data-testid="solfeggio-chip-432")
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 text to surface contrast ratio with pure white or infrared glow for active labels

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve all existing audio callbacks (AudioEngine.playCamelot, playMulti, etc.) and state logic.
Do not add any full-screen raster overlay images that capture touch events.
Inject SVG Defs (<LinearGradient>, <RadialGradient>) into react-native-svg renders for MirrorsWheel.tsx and FrequencyMap.tsx.
Apply layered SVG strokes for chrome bevels directly onto Path, SvgCircle, Rect, and Polygon components.
Ensure skin switching and skinStyles compatibility via the SK() helper function.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, nodes, tabs, chips) MUST include data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.alignment: Never force centered text inside asymmetric UI layouts without purposeful intent.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.borders: Never rely on un-bordered transparent overlays over canvas or SVG graphics.
